description: isSameOrigin does not perform proper RFC 6454 origin normalization. REQ-AUTH-008 specifies 'Compare scheme (case-insensitive), host (case-insensitive), and port (explicit or default per scheme)'. The implementation uses simple string equality (requestOrigin === allowedOrigin) after only validating that both are parseable URLs. This means: (1) 'https://EXAMPLE.COM' vs 'https://example.com' returns false, but per RFC origins these are the same origin. (2) 'https://example.com:443' vs 'https://example.com' returns false, but port 443 is the default for https. The test at line 309 acknowledges this as expected behavior, but the spec explicitly requires case-insensitive and default-port-aware comparison.
